decision_record.calculation: Fixture: qualifier close 50 (signal week), current bar close 60 (+20% drift), per-name budget 3000. Control: qty 6 at hint 50 -> fills ~3600 of notional, 20% over budget. Treatment: qty 5 at hint 60 -> 3000, on budget.
decision_record.comparison: Pre-change rule: qty and price_hint computed from the qualifier's signal-week close (the M2 study close, up to a week old), while the market order fills at the current price.
decision_record.experiment: Adapters3 A/B on identical qualifier+bars: treatment reprices off the last served 1Day close; control (OFF) reproduces qty 6 / hint 50 exactly. Falsifier: no bars served for the symbol — gate leaves the intent untouched (qualifier basis remains the fallback, as pre-change).
decision_record.mechanism: Execution pricing: stale sizing price. Selection (is_beaten_down on the qualifier record) is the frozen law and is untouched; only the sizing/price basis moves to the served current bar.
decision_record.transfer: The sleeve's per-name budget (30% sleeve cap / 10 names = 3% of equity) is the risk contract; it is honored only if sizing uses the price the market will actually fill at.

switch: extra.beatendown_enh2.current_bar_pricing default ON; OFF restores qualifier-close sizing exactly
